2608.13409.title: Jointly Predicting Courses and Grades Using a Transformer-Based Model
2608.13409.paper_summary: Existing predictive models in learning analytics often treat student academic history as a simple sequence, overlooking the concurrent nature of courses taken within a semester. This simplification can lead to inaccurate performance predictions, particularly for students with heavy or challenging course loads. This paper introduces a TRansformer for Academic Course-grade Estimation (TRACE) that addresses this limitation by jointly predicting both the set of courses a student will take and their corresponding grades for an upcoming semester. Our approach encodes courses on a per-semester basis to capture the effects of course concurrency and utilizes a novel loss function combining course-set prediction with grade prediction. We demonstrate that predicting courses taken in addition to the grades in those courses leads to significant improvements in prediction quality. Trained on ten years of institutional data, our joint prediction model reduces mean absolute error by nearly 50% compared to an identical architecture that predicts grades alone. The model also outperforms traditional LSTM-based sequential models, as well as graph neural network-based approaches, and offers natural ways to incorporate student attribute data. This work demonstrates the utility of modern neural architectures for creating interpretable models that can be adapted to new institutions via retraining and recalibration, as well as the importance of key techniques, such as predicting courses taken during training. We discuss how this model could be incorporated into early detection systems at institutions of higher education.
2608.13409.paper_summary_zh: 現有的學習分析預測模型通常將學生的學業歷史視為一個簡單的序列，忽視了學期內所修課程的同時性。這種簡化可能導致不準確的表現預測，特別是對於課程負擔重或具有挑戰性的學生。本文介紹了一種用於學術課程成績預測的Transformer（TRansformer for Academic Course-grade Estimation, TRACE），該模型通過共同預測學生將修讀的課程集合及其相應的成績來解決這一限制。我們的方法按學期編碼課程，以捕捉課程同時性的影響，並利用一種新穎的損失函數，將課程集合預測與成績預測相結合。我們證明，除了預測課程的成績外，預測所修課程也能顯著提高預測質量。基於十年的機構數據訓練，我們的聯合預測模型將平均絕對誤差降低了近50%，與僅預測成績的相同架構相比。該模型還優於傳統的基於LSTM的序列模型以及基於圖神經網絡的方法，並提供了自然的方式來整合學生屬性數據。這項工作展示了現代神經架構在創建可解釋模型方面的實用性，這些模型可以通過再訓練和重新校準適應新的機構，以及關鍵技術的重要性，例如在訓練期間預測所修課程。我們討論了這個模型如何可以納入高等教育機構的早期檢測系統中。
